BL-998 — five shell tests execute the receive/completion dispatcher from the REAL scripts dir while cd'd into a fixture, so ready_for_next resolves the real repo root - the tests prove nothing about their fixtures AND a suite run can claim a live parcel out of a real role's mailbox
What it solves: Source: hardender note 20260820T160724Z_000286, "5 more tests may share BL-983 cd-into-real-repo trap I fixed, unverified".
The count was RIGHT, and it is worth recording that it was verified rather than taken on trust, because two cruder sweeps gave badly wrong answers. A tight co-occurrence filte…
Approval context: One thing needs your judgement, and it is about how to verify rather than what to build.
Step 2 of the QA procedure asks someone to demonstrate the theft - to show that the unfixed test really does reach into a live mailbox. That is the evidence that makes `high` honest rather than asserted, but it…
BL-998 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-998" (or "reject BL-998 <reason>") to act.
